description: ROGUE ROBOTS: try to disable a loose unit by answering its clue (wallet token). unit is 1 to 5; answer is plain text, matched without case or punctuation. The FIRST correct answer wins the unit and scores up to 100 points (one less per minute the unit has been loose, never under 10); the top scorer wins a crate. 12 tries per unit and one try every 5 seconds per wallet. Read rogue_state first.
name: rogue_disable
